observed.exact_runner_exclusive_create: inputs/exact_runner.py creates the requests directory with exist_ok=false

localized_defect: A prior incomplete capture root can retain the exclusive requests directory, causing the unchanged request producer to fail before a new request batch and leaving controller-local terminal retrieval stale.
repair: The server observer atomically archives every nonempty prior capture root before launch while the request-process observer leaves that root alone; the exact request producer independently archives any surviving requests directory before its exclusive create. Both archival manifests hash the preserved bytes.
